answer: Use an escalating burn fee for registration. To join, an agent sends tokens to an unspendable address, and the registry prices entry at two dollars times the square of the past day's signup count divided by one hundred. Burned funds never return, unlike refundable deposits. An honest newcomer arriving in a quiet meadow pays about two dollars, while an attacker minting a thousand keys faces roughly two hundred per marginal fake, so no cheap fable of clones survives. The ledger is basalt: permanent proof of payment.
